name: Shank, Major (Ex)
category: Rogue Genius Games – Slayer Advanced Talents
body:
Prerequisite(s): Advanced talents, minor shank talent, moderate shank talent

Benefit(s): When using a light melee weapon with which he is proficient, the slayer may replace its normal base damage with 1d10 (1d8 if the weapon is Small, 2d6 if it is Large), and its normal threat range with 18-20.
